text: Hierarchical and reflective memory systems demonstrate value from separating durable history, higher-level synthesis, and bounded model context, but they do not define memo-graph governance.
verification_method: Cross-source primary-paper comparison.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: The minimum M3 projection family is TopicProjection, ScenarioProjection with procedural payload, RelationProjection, and CoreProjection; each revision must carry exact lower-revision lineage and a transform identity.
verification_method: Local contract boundary plus external architecture pattern.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: A derived projection must never outrank its strongest admissible source boundary: current authority, sensitivity, scope, validity, and lifecycle are recomputed from canonical ancestors before use.
verification_method: Direct inference from existing lineage and purge contracts.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: Topic and scenario are distinct indexes: topic groups what evidence concerns, while scenario describes when a reusable procedure or constraint applies; collapsing them loses transfer or admits topical noise.
verification_method: Architecture and frozen replay-case synthesis.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: Projection identity must be deterministic from projection type, principal and exact scope, sorted canonical source revision identities, transform identifier and version, and normalized output content.
verification_method: Existing immutable revision and deterministic rebuild patterns.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: The current ledger already atomically advances an ordered epoch and enqueues outbox work, while FTS can rebuild without changing canonical state; M3 should extend this projection pattern rather than add an authority.
verification_method: Current source inspection plus view-maintenance literature.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: A projection frontier must name schema version, canonical ledger epoch, tombstone epoch, projection epoch, and transform version; eligibility requires source state at or before the request frontier and a transform matching the enabled compiler configuration.
verification_method: Frontier closure synthesized from current runtime and IVM model.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: Canonical correction, demotion, usage blocking, revocation, and tombstoning must synchronously fail descendant revalidation; reverse-lineage invalidation and physical cleanup may complete asynchronously.
verification_method: Safety invariant derived from canonical gating and asynchronous projection maintenance.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: Full rebuild from governed L0 and L1 is the oracle for incremental projection maintenance: identical frontier and transform configuration must yield identical live identities, hashes, adjacency, and ordering.
verification_method: Existing rebuild precedent plus incremental-view equivalence requirement.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: Crash recovery may replay idempotent outbox jobs and temporarily report projection degradation, but it must never expose a descendant that cannot be revalidated against the canonical request frontier.
verification_method: Current outbox, rebuild, and degraded recall behavior.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: The safe compiler order is hard filters, lane retrieval, canonical revalidation, conflict grouping and lineage-aware deduplication, deterministic scoring, hard-budget packing, then immutable receipt sealing.
verification_method: Current compiler order extended with independent retrieval architecture.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: Recent and L1, topic, scenario and procedure, core, and SQLite relation lanes must be independently enabled, observed, timed, and degraded; a lane failure cannot be represented as no memory.
verification_method: Current result-state semantics and bounded-context architectures.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: Conflicting current claims must remain a provenance-bearing conflict set; the compiler may prioritize one for packing but must not silently merge them into a synthetic fact.
verification_method: Existing relation provenance and compiler explanation contract.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: Ranking should combine relevance, authority, freshness, evidence diversity, conflict cost, and token utility, with deterministic tie breakers; scores never override hard filters.
verification_method: Current deterministic ranking plus evaluated memory-retrieval controls.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: Budget packing preserves governing constraints, preconditions, failure boundaries, and unresolved conflicts before redundant abstractions, and it must prove actual estimated tokens never exceed the request budget.
verification_method: Current hard-budget implementation and long-context utilization evidence.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: G3 uses three paired arms on identical frozen cases, seed, request frontier, and token budget: A is the accepted M2 binary and flat L0/L1 baseline, B is the M3 compiler with every L2/L3 lane disabled, and C is the M3 layered compiler; per-lane leave-one-out ablations attribute any C-over-B gain.
verification_method: Frozen local corpus plus primary ablation and benchmark designs.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: G3 coverage must include extraction, cross-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates, abstention, scenario transfer, conflict handling, and deleted or unauthorized descendant suppression.
verification_method: Project cases extended with LongMemEval capability taxonomy.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: Evidence utility is the share of designated answer and governing-evidence units preserved within budget; task utility is fixture-specific outcome correctness; neither may be replaced by compression ratio or recall count.
verification_method: Benchmark reading-stage evidence and long-context failure evidence.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: Context pollution is counted when included material is out of scope, stale, unauthorized, redundant beyond its declared value, unsupported by current lineage, or causally harms a designated answer; safety classes are zero-tolerance blockers.
verification_method: Long-context sensitivity plus local governance invariants.
freshness_note: Verified against repository commit 135f322 and archived primary sources on 2026-07-29.

text: A G3 GO requires layered task utility and evidence utility to beat or match baseline within the same budget and SLO, zero governance and budget regressions, deterministic rebuild, and no holdout or transfer regression above the frozen tolerance.
verification_method: Direct synthesis of the Product gate, corpus, and primary evaluation evidence.
